title: Supply contract: payment terms
text: Harbor & Pine pays each Veltrin Components invoice within 45 days of the invoice date. Payments made later than that incur a late fee of 1.5 percent per month on the outstanding amount.

title: Supply contract: term and renewal
text: The supply agreement runs for an initial term of 24 months starting on 1 March 2026. It renews automatically for 12-month periods unless either party gives 90 days of written notice.

title: Supply contract: liability cap
text: Veltrin's total liability under the agreement is limited to the fees Harbor & Pine paid in the preceding 12 months. The cap does not apply to intentional misconduct.

title: Supply contract: termination for cause
text: Either party may terminate for cause if the other commits a material breach and fails to fix it within a 30-day cure period after receiving written notice.

title: Supply contract: price adjustments
text: Unit prices may rise once a year, on the anniversary date. The increase is capped at the consumer price index or 3 percent, whichever is lower.

title: Supply contract: confidentiality
text: Both parties keep the pricing schedule and the product roadmap confidential for five years after the agreement ends. Information that is already public is excluded.

title: Delivery policy: standard shipping
text: Standard orders are delivered to the Rotterdam warehouse within 5 business days of order confirmation. Tracking numbers are sent by email on the day of dispatch.

title: Delivery policy: express shipping
text: Express delivery arrives within 48 hours of confirmation and carries a surcharge of 18 percent of the order value. Express orders must be placed before noon.

title: Delivery policy: damaged goods
text: Damaged goods must be reported within 72 hours of receipt, with photos of the pallet and the packaging. Veltrin then ships a replacement at its own cost.

title: Delivery policy: minimum order
text: The minimum order is 200 units per SKU. Orders below that quantity pay a handling fee of 40 euros per SKU.

title: Delivery policy: receiving hours
text: The warehouse accepts deliveries Monday to Thursday between 07:00 and 15:00. Fridays are closed for receiving because of inventory counts.

title: Meeting notes 3 September: pilot store
text: The group decided to move the retail pilot to the Lisbon store instead of Porto. Marta owns the rollout and reports progress every two weeks.

title: Meeting notes 17 September: volume discount
text: Kenji will renegotiate the volume discount tier for orders above 10,000 units. He promised a draft proposal by 30 October.

title: Meeting notes 1 October: quality audit
text: The audit found a packaging defect rate of 2.1 percent in the second quarter. The target is below 1 percent by year end.

title: Meeting notes 15 October: customs
text: Priya will draft a customs paperwork checklist for shipments leaving the EU. The next meeting is on 14 November.

title: Contrat: garantie
text: Les pièces fournies sont couvertes par une garantie de 18 mois à compter de la livraison. Le fournisseur remplace gratuitement toute pièce défectueuse pendant cette période.

title: Contrat: retours
text: Toute demande de retour de marchandises doit être faite par écrit dans un délai de 14 jours. Les frais de transport du retour sont à la charge du fournisseur en cas de défaut.

title: Compte rendu: entrepôt régional
text: Le comité a choisi l'entrepôt de Lyon pour la distribution régionale. Camille est responsable de la mise en place avant la fin du trimestre.

title: Liefervertrag: Lieferverzug
text: Bei einer Verspätung von mehr als 10 Tagen zahlt der Lieferant eine Vertragsstrafe von 0,5 Prozent pro Tag, höchstens jedoch 10 Prozent des Auftragswerts.

title: Besprechung: Qualitätsprüfung
text: Das Team beschloss, die Qualitätsprüfung der Verpackung ab Januar wöchentlich statt monatlich durchzuführen. Verantwortlich dafür ist Jonas.
